title: RingSettings
description: Device-local ring settings exposed to Flutter. The raw Android ringtone URI is Kotlin-private and is never present in this payload.

revision.description: Monotonic device-local settings revision used for optimistic concurrency.

ringtone_display_name.description: Android-resolved display name only; never a URI or file path.

ringtone_available.description: Whether the stored selection currently resolves. False causes Kotlin to use the default Alarm ringtone.

strong_reminder_enabled.description: User preference to request full-screen presentation when platform capability permits it.
